method: Coordinator directly built observed public configuration and operated the loopback previews through CUA. No helper runner or subagent.
readOnlyBasis: Fresh tabs/origins; no wallet or sign-in action performed.
wallet/session.ts uses tab-scoped sessionStorage; ApiSwitch and ApiSwitchV2 choose cached demo APIs when no session token exists, even with public backend configuration present.
VITE_ALLOW_MOCK_AUTH=0 in both production builds; no authenticated session was created.
limitations: Manual UI/console observation and reviewed guest-mode routing, not a new instrumented network trace or proof that the HTTP repair is deployed. No backend release, wallet transaction or sign-in.
setupCorrections: A requested1600 override set before creating one tab left its actual viewport1280x720. That observation was excluded from1600 certification; a fresh origin was used and1600x900 measured before actions.
One stale accessibility index after modal removal was rejected before action; a fresh state and current control were used. No app assertion was bypassed.
